integrity: The complex-plane assertion has an algebraic Schur–Cohn proof, supplemented by standalone symbolic verification. External independent review and exhaustive historical priority are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Precisely period-two positive steps and scalar constant-coefficient test equation in exact arithmetic; does not establish general nonperiodic-grid, nonlinear SSAV energy, or uniform ratio-independent imaginary-axis damping. Priority against inaccessible variable-step deferred-correction full text remains uncertain.
title: Unrestricted complex half-plane stability of two-periodic variable-step BDF2 and its Crank–Nicolson limit
